a.title: The new Apple TV 4K has built-in microphones so you can talk to Siri AI

b.lede: The new Apple TV 4K costs $299, comes with Siri AI, and will be available on November 13.
b.title: Apple launches a new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI and remote-free commands
